Active.description: The Active variable is TRUE if this particular emergency stop function is active, e.g. that the emergency stop button is pressed, FALSE otherwise.

Name.description: The Name of the EmergencyStopFunctionType provides a manufacturer-specific emergency stop function identifier within the safety system.
